name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: 'master'

jobs:
  build_site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL }}
      PUBLIC_FACEBOOK_AUTHOR_PAGE: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_FACEBOOK_AUTHOR_PAGE }}
      PUBLIC_FACEBOOK_PAGE: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_FACEBOOK_PAGE }}
      PUBLIC_GITHUB_PAGE: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_GITHUB_PAGE }}
      PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PROFILE: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PROFILE }}
      PUBLIC_SITE_URL: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_SITE_URL }}
      PUBLIC_DOMAIN: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_DOMAIN }}
      PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_USERNAME: ''
      PUBLIC_TIKTOK_USERNAME: ''
      PUBLIC_TWITTER_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_TWITTER_USERNAME }}
      PUBLIC_TWITTER_USER_ID: ''
      PUBLIC_WIRE_USERNAME: ''

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      # If you're using pnpm, add this step then change the commands and cache key below to use `pnpm`
      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8

      #   - name: Install Node.js
      #     uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      #     with:
      #       node-version: 18
      #       cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: build
        env:
          BASE_PATH: '/${{ github.event.repository.name }}'
        run: |
          pnpm run build

      # Step to create CNAME file for the custom domain
      - name: Create CNAME file
        run: echo "gabrielcm.dev" > build/CNAME

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v2
        with:
          # this should match the `pages` option in your adapter-static options
          path: 'build/'

  deploy:
    needs: build_site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}

    steps:
      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v2
